summary: Almaden Minerals filed a Form 6-K presenting a press release updating its international arbitration claim against Mexico under the CPTPP, noting the hearing was rescheduled from December 2026 to July 2027 and extended to ten days. The release also announces the renewal of its shareholder rights plan (approved June 25, 2026) and a grant of 800,000 stock options to a director at $0.27 per share expiring 2031. These are routine operational and legal updates, not a special-situation transaction. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The arbitration is an ongoing dispute, and the rights plan renewal and option grant are ordinary governance matters—no special-situation category applies.
